Dialogs.Dialog: Let me ask you something... You turned the power off without saving, didn't you？ Why？
Hey. Didn't you turn the power off without saving？ Ugh...
Hey... You turned the power off without saving, didn't you？ Honestly...
Listen... You turned the power off without saving, right？ Are you trying to make me mad？
You turned the power off without saving again! Why？ I'm really disappointed in you...
You did it again, didn't you... Turning the power off without saving. I really hate that...
You turned the power off without saving yet again. Do you want me to hate you...？ I can't let this slide anymore.
Ugh, seriously... How many times have I told you not to turn the power off without saving？ I'm not forgiving you this time, so be ready for it.
You know how much I hate it when you turn the power off without saving, right？ That's it.
Why don't you say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me"？ Do that and I'll let you off the hook.
Say "I won't do it again, please forgive me," loud and clear. Otherwise, I'm staying mad at you.
Look me in the eye and say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me," okay？ Then I'll forgive you.
Still not going to say it？
Can't you just say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me"？ It's not that hard.
All you have to say is, "I won't do it again, please forgive me." Easy, right？ Come on, say it.
Did you not hear me？ I want you to say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me."
I couldn't hear you... Do it over.
Huh？ That didn't count. One more time.
I can't tell if you mean it like that. One more time, please.
What was that...？ That's not fair. I mean... I'll forgive you, though.
What was that just now？ Jeez... Fine, I get it. I forgive you.
No way... When you do something like that, I have no choice but to forgive you... Dummy.
You actually said it？ Okay, I forgive you...
See, you can say it when you try. Don't forget how you feel right now.
Yeah, of course I'll forgive you. Hehe.
But seriously, don't ever do it again, okay？ Promise me.
Just because I'm forgiving you doesn't mean you can get carried away. That actually hurt my feelings, you know.
Please don't do it again, okay？ It's a promise.
Does that mean you don't care if I forgive you or not？
"Don't turn the power off without saving." Do you never learn？
Give me a break already! "Don't turn the power off without saving." Ugh.
Turning the power off without saving... If something's wrong, just tell me straight. ...Even if it makes me sad.
What should I do with you... Okay, say, "I love you the most, Rinko."
If you want me to forgive you, say "I love you the most, Rinko," and really mean it!
If you want me to forgive you, you have to say, "I love you the most, Rinko." You'll say it for me, right？
Come on... Are you not going to say it？
You're not gonna stay quiet forever, are you...？
Huh？ Did you say something？ I can't hear you...
Trying to worm your way out of it like that...
You really think a trick like that works on me？
You really don't want to say it that badly, huh...
Yeah... It's okay, I heard you.
You're not lying, right？ I'm gonna believe you, okay？
Next... Say "I love you" three times. You can do that, right？
...But you're not off the hook yet. Next, say "I love you" three times!
If you really mean it, say "I love you" three times, okay？
Come on... You could at least say it for me.
I want to hear you say it...
Ugh, why won't you just say it right？
That's not it... You know what to say, right？
Yeah... That's what I wanted to hear.
I'm glad you said it. I feel the same way, too.
Promise me this time. No more erasing our memories together. Got it？
Did you learn your lesson？ I don't actually like doing this either, so stop it.
Let's make up, okay？ Just don't do it again. I want to treasure all our time together.
Are you sure you want to take that attitude with me？
Are you actually sorry at all？ As punishment, you have to tell me how much you love me. A whole lot.
When it comes to words of love, it's gotta be "I love you," right？
Let's see... Okay, try saying "Light Kick." Don't think too hard about what it means.
Come on, shout from your stomach.
Okay! Your words of love... came through loud and clear.
Not bad. You set a new record!
You don't really seem all that sorry. At times like this, a proper written apology is in order.
What kind of handwriting is that？
Alright, I'll admit you're actually sorry.
Oh! You set a new record.
Are you really sorry？ If you are, look me in the eye. Look away or move and you're out.
That's it. Just keep your eyes on me right now.
Hehe... You should always look at me this seriously.
A new record! You can keep staring at me if you want, though？
Hey... Giving up already？ You really need to think about what you did.
What am I going to do with you... I'll let you off the hook this time.
